prompts.title: 30-second domino chain-reaction spectacle (video)
prompts.tool: Seedance 2.5 or any text-to-video AI with audio
prompts.prompt:
Create a completely original 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic spectacle featuring an enormous city-wide domino experiment during a beautiful sunny afternoon.

STORY: A young engineer attempts to activate the world's largest domino chain reaction, but one unexpected object changes the entire experiment.

SCENE 1 (0–5s):
A huge public plaza is filled with thousands of colorful oversized domino blocks arranged across streets, stairs, fountains and specially designed platforms. A young engineer named Leo stands beside a control table.

LEO: "Ladies and gentlemen, today we're breaking a world record!"
REPORTER: "How long did it take to build all this?"
LEO: "Six months. And hopefully only thirty seconds to destroy it!"

SCENE 2 (5–10s):
The reporter approaches the starting domino. A large crowd watches with excitement.

REPORTER: "Are you absolutely sure this will work?"
LEO: "Every single block has been checked. Let's begin!"

SCENE 3 (10–15s):
Leo gently pushes the first giant domino. Thousands of blocks begin falling in a spectacular sequence through the plaza. The camera follows the chain reaction through different angles.

CROWD: "WOW!"
REPORTER: "Look at that! It's actually working!"

SCENE 4 (15–20s):
The domino chain reaches a large fountain. One final block hits a specially designed lever, activating a hidden mechanical platform. Suddenly, a gigantic colorful inflatable ball rises into the air.

LEO: "Wait! That wasn't part of the plan!"
REPORTER: "What did you just activate?"

SCENE 5 (20–25s):
The giant inflatable ball rolls down a ramp and accidentally knocks over another line of enormous domino blocks. The chain reaction continues across the plaza.

LEO: "Oh no! There's another sequence!"
REPORTER: "You planned two records in one day?"

SCENE 6 (25–30s):
The final domino hits a giant button. Hundreds of colorful water fountains activate simultaneously, creating a spectacular synchronized water display. The entire crowd cheers.

LEO: "Okay... I'll admit that was better than my original plan!"
REPORTER: "That's the best accident I've ever witnessed!"

End with a breathtaking aerial view of the colorful plaza and synchronized fountains.

VISUAL QUALITY: Photorealistic large-scale engineering spectacle, bright natural daylight, detailed colorful domino blocks, physically accurate collisions, realistic object momentum, water simulations, dynamic cinematic camera movements, 4K.

AUDIO: Natural English conversations, accurate lip-sync, excited crowd reactions, domino impacts, rolling ball sounds, mechanical lever clicks, fountain water, cheering and energetic original orchestral music. Sound effects must synchronize precisely with every falling block.

IMPORTANT: Maintain continuous physical domino motion with believable collision physics. Original installation design, original characters and story. No existing movie references, no copyrighted characters, no narration, no subtitles, no cartoon appearance.
prompts.why: A full shot-by-shot script: six 5-second scenes with dialogue, then separate VISUAL QUALITY and AUDIO blocks. Copy the structure and swap the story to script your own short video.
prompts.author: @Strength04_X
